The '''Maximum Security Thoroughfare''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] complex that served as a roadway, linking several of the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] to the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]
